item.title: KernelCTF 2021 Writeups
item.description:
Hey, there! After a looong gap, I’m back to CTFs.
I have played KernelCTF 2021 with team zh3r0 . We ended up at #9 worldwide.
I solved 3 Misc challenges – Progressive Dynamite, Bogo Solve & Bogo Attack.
